answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because willow only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Any umber approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
